mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in the federal funds rate signals monetary tightening, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns despite FEDFUNDS rising >1% over 3 months (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% triggers a labor market strengthening signal, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 5.0% in a 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in demand (GDPC1) and fall in supply (INDPRO) both exceeding 2% in the same month creates inflationary pressure, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises >2% and INDPRO falls >2% in the same month
failure_condition: The combination occurs but SPX returns are negative (p < 0.05) over the 60-day horizon, or returns are not significantly positive when the combo is present.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained 1% rise in the federal funds rate over 3 months amplifies risk aversion, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns despite FEDFUNDS rising >1% over 3 months (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in labor participation rate (PAYEMS) above 130,000 workers signals a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when PAYEMS rise >1% month-over-month for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in GDP demand (GDPC1) exceeding 14,000 billion chained 2017 dollars triggers optimism about economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 crosses above 14,000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in demand (GDPC1) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) both exceeding 3% in the same month creates conflicting signals, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises >3% and FEDFUNDS rises >3% in the same month
failure_condition: The combination occurs but SPX returns are positive (p < 0.05) over the 5-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a monthly decline in supply (INDPRO) below 92.5 triggers concerns about overproduction and weak demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO falls below 92.5.
